title: Arrays and Array Methods
summary: Keep many values in one list, then loop through them and reshape them.
heading: Arrays and Array Methods

blocks.text: An array is a single list that holds many values in order. You reach each value by its position number, called the index — and counting starts at 0, not 1.

blocks.caption: Each item sits at a numbered position, starting at 0.

blocks.text: forEach runs a little function once for every item in the list. Arrow functions keep it nice and short.

sections.title: map and filter with arrow functions

blocks.text: map takes each item and builds a brand-new list from the results. filter keeps only the items that pass a test you give it.

items: An array is an ordered list, and counting starts at 0.
forEach runs your code for each item.
filter keeps only the items that pass your test.
Arrow functions make these read like one clean line.
